name: @softn/runtime-shell
description: What every host that runs one .softn bundle in a browser shares: reading and composing the bundle (bundleProcessor), warming its first screen off the main thread (zipWarmup + zipWorker), the slim frame bar drawn over an app, and consent — the rule that withholds what a bundle declared until the person allows it (consent), with the bar and dialog that ask (PermissionBar, PermissionPrompt). The web runtime, the single-app shell and the desktop loader all build on it; none of them owns it.
